name: dice
description: Rolls dice, flips coins and picks something at random.
author: Jarvis examples
guide: dice rolls (including notation like 2d6+3), coin flips, picking one of several things at random

tools.name: roll_dice
tools.description: Roll dice. Use for "roll a d20", "roll 3d6+2", "roll two dice". notation: dice notation like 2d6, d20 or 4d8+3 (default 1d6). Returns every roll and the total.

tools.name: flip_coin
tools.description: Flip a coin (or several). Use for "heads or tails", "flip a coin". count: how many flips (default 1). Returns each result.

tools.name: pick_one
tools.description: Pick one (or a few) at random from a list. Use for "choose for me", "pick a movie from these", "who goes first". options: the choices. count: how many to pick, without repeats (default 1).
